The protein roll

A treat that doesn’t require a cheat.

16gProtein per roll
Plant-based
ClassicOur whipped frosting.
Classic LightGlazed, lighter.

The roll you crave, built to fuel your day. This year we developed a brand-new plant-based dough with 16g of protein in every roll, and it’s still soft, warm and glazed like it should be. It’s personal for us. Chef Shalom lost more than 100 pounds without giving up what he loved, and as chefs we wanted everyone to have a treat that never feels like a setback.

03
Our story

Why we move.

We move to feel good in our bodies, to clear our minds, and to come together. Donutste Fit brings food, fitness and music into one room, because healthy should feel like a celebration, not a punishment.

For us, it’s personal. Chef Shalom lost more than 100 pounds without giving up what he loved. Chef Victoria is on her own fitness journey after recovering from a pregnancy loss, rebuilding her strength one day at a time. We’re not here as perfect examples. We’re here moving right beside you.
